description: This file contains functions for stock balance reposting, stock quantity calculations, and serial number reconciliation in an ERP system, specifically for stock management in ERPNext.

methods.name: repost
methods.description: Main function to trigger reposting of stock quantities for all items and warehouses, with options for negative stock and zero rate allowances.

methods.name: repost_stock
methods.description: Recalculates and updates stock quantities for a specific item and warehouse.

methods.name: repost_actual_qty
methods.description: Creates a stock ledger entry for stock reconciliation at a fixed date.

methods.name: get_balance_qty_from_sle
methods.description: Fetches the latest stock quantity after transactions for an item in a warehouse.

methods.name: get_reserved_qty
methods.description: Calculates the reserved quantity based on sales orders and packed items.

methods.name: get_indented_qty
methods.description: Calculates the quantity requested in material requests that is not yet fulfilled.

methods.name: get_ordered_qty
methods.description: Calculates the total purchase order quantity pending receipt.

methods.name: get_planned_qty
methods.description: Calculates the planned production quantity in work orders.

methods.name: update_bin_qty
methods.description: Updates the stock bin with new quantity values.

methods.name: set_stock_balance_as_per_serial_no
methods.description: Adjusts stock balances based on serial number counts and last ledger entries.

methods.name: reset_serial_no_status_and_warehouse
methods.description: Resets serial number status and warehouse info for unconfirmed serials.
